records.name: MacMusicPlayer
records.tagline: A clean, lightweight music player for macOS.
records.description: A clean, lightweight music player for macOS. Contribute to samzong/MacMusicPlayer development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: New small business tools by IFTTT
records.tagline: Run your business with HubSpot, Figma, and more
records.description: A whole new stack of business tools just hit IFTTT. Connect HubSpot, Figma, Customer.io, Xero, FreshBooks, SendGrid, Apollo, and 13 more to automate the parts of running a business that eat up your time. Whether you're onboarding a new hire, sending invoices, launching a product, or keeping your website up, it all runs once connected. Even your domain expiration won't catch you off guard. Hook it all up to Slack, Google Sheets, SMS, and more.

records.name: TrustSense
records.tagline: Every Important Document Deserves Trust.
records.description: Every day, HR teams issue documents while recruiters, banks, and background verification companies spend time verifying them manually. TrustSense connects both sides by enabling organizations to issue instantly verifiable documents, reducing HR workload, preventing document fraud, accelerating background verification, and building trust across every important business document.

records.name: Smara - Money Tracker
records.tagline: Upload any bank statements and combine your accounts
records.description: A simple, fast money tracker. Type a row and smart suggestions fill in the rest, or upload a bank statement and the month sorts itself. No bank connection. We got tired of opening five different bank and card statements every month and piecing them together by hand in a spreadsheet, and we didn't want to hand our bank logins to anyone. So we built Smara. You upload a statement from any bank or e-wallet and it reads the month and drops every transaction into one combined view.

records.name: TaxEd Abroad
records.tagline: Simplify expat taxes, anywhere, Free, no sign-up needed.
records.description: TaxEd Abroad replaces US-centric tax software with an expat-first experience. We translate complex IRS rules into country-specific, timezone-aware deadlines and clear steps for foreign income, FEIE, and tax treaties. No jargon, just actionable checklists that turn tax season into a 15‑minute check‑in.

records.name: WisyLink
records.tagline: Create real websites, apps, and games with chatting AI
records.description: WisyLink turns a chat into a live website, app, or tool — no code. Hosted on its own address, with a real backend already wired in: accounts, a database, payment collection, and file storage, plus live updates and multiplayer when you need them. Bring your own domain or use a WisyLink one. Keep shaping it by chatting — the link never changes. Free to start, on web, iOS, and Android.

records.name: Link Preview API
records.tagline: Free API to get Open Graph data, title & images for any URL
records.description: Completely free. Get back everything you need to render a rich link card in your app – the kind you see in Slack, iMessage, or Twitter when someone pastes a link. Dedicated handling for popular websites like YouTube, Amazon, Twitter, Airbnb, SoundCloud, NYT, Vimeo, Giphy, and more. These return reliable, high-quality previews every time. Built in image validation, and JavaScript rendering. Works directly from the browser, no proxy server required. Free usage up to 20,000 link previews.

records.name: Web Paint
records.tagline: "Windows MS Paint in your browser. No login, 100% free."
records.description: Free online paint tool and MS Paint alternative. Draw, crop, select, add text, use brushes and shapes, and save images directly in your browser.

records.name: 3spread brings you free SEC data
records.tagline: Free, standardized, and available through our API
records.description: Now in beta! Most data providers are looking to sell you SEC data. We at 3spread think that's ridiculous, and have made our standardized SEC data completely free through our robust API. Sign up and start pulling data immediately! The data was always yours, we're just here to make it usable.

records.name: Klich
records.tagline: Turn "who's in?" into a one-tap group poll
records.description: Klich gets your group to a decision. Instead of "anyone up for tonight?" dying in the chat, send a one-tap "I'm in / I'm out" poll, share one link, and see who's in — live. Built for gaming squads, pickup sports, events, trips, and work teams. Reusable templates, deadlines, reminders that only nudge non-voters, and a decision history. In beta: Telegram mirroring + AI agents can poll your group via MCP. Free, no ads, no tracking. iOS + Android.

records.name: On-Device Field Extraction by Veryfi
records.tagline: Secure on-device extraction even if you're offline
records.description: Today we're introducing On-Device Field Detection, a new capability in the Veryfi Lens SDK that validates receipts the moment they're captured, not after they've been uploaded, processed, and potentially rejected. It's a small shift in when validation happens, and it changes a lot about what happens next.

records.name: EZ Hishab
records.tagline: POS, Inventory & Accounting Software for Bangladesh
records.description: EZ Hishab — বাংলাদেশের ছোট ও মাঝারি ব্যবসার জন্য ক্লাউড-ভিত্তিক POS, ইনভেন্টরি, অ্যাকাউন্টিং ও ERP সফটওয়্যার। গ্রোসারি, রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্লথিং, ইলেকট্রনিক্সসহ ৩৪টি ইন্ডাস্ট্রির জন্য বিশেষ সুবিধা। মাসিক মাত্র ৳৮০০। ১৪ দিন বিনামূল্যে ট্রায়াল।

records.name: Jobifer AI
records.tagline: Your AI assistant for a smarter job hunt.
records.description: Jobifer helps make job searching less overwhelming. It finds roles that match your experience, helps tailor your CV for each opportunity, and assists you in reaching the right hiring people with personalized outreach. Instead of spending hours on repetitive tasks, you can focus on the opportunities that matter most.

records.name: Kial
records.tagline: A finance app you build yourself
records.description: Most finance apps lock you into one method and a fixed layout. Kial is different: your home is a dashboard you build yourself from 30+ live widgets, arranged however you think about money — something no other finance app offers. Track accounts, cards & net worth with real balances, no bank-linking (private, works anywhere). Snap a receipt to auto-fill merchant, items & total. Start one-tap simple or go deep: budgets, savings, recurring & insights. iOS & Android, 8 languages.

records.name: TopoForest (拓扑森林)
records.tagline: AI-powered business education for OPC builders
records.description: TopoForest helps Chinese-speaking entrepreneurs build AI-powered one-person companies with zero coding. 6,000+ students, 76% profitable. We teach AI development, SaaS, payments, and SEO — all in Chinese. Project-based courses with mentorship and weekly updates. Our "OPC VibeCoding" course takes you from zero to a USD-payment SaaS product. We don't just teach tools; we rebuild how you think about business.

records.name: Energetic Focus Implementation Guide
records.tagline: Actionable cheat sheets to master focus architecture
records.description: The Energetic Focus Implementation Guide is a 3-phase, 9-part system built to turn performance theories into tactical daily actions. This guide is a direct companion to the core Energetic Focus ebook—be sure to check out the main framework as well! It provides step-by-step cheat sheets for neuroergonomic workspace design, AI flow architecture, and task gamification to bridge the gap between high-level visionary goals and physical execution.

records.name: Cutrix
records.tagline: AI-powered video translation that preserves speaker's voice
records.description: Stop settling for robotic dubbing. Cutrix uses an Agentic workflow to translate videos while preserving the speaker's original emotion and natural pacing. Experience hyper-natural alignment without the steep learning curve. Sign up for free credits today!

records.name: PilotIQ Logbook
records.tagline: Log flights offline and track currency, duty limits.
records.description: PilotIQ is the operating system for pilot readiness — a fast, offline-first digital logbook built around CASA, FAA and EASA support. Log a flight in seconds, always know if you're current, and see your whole flying career at a glance. DIGITAL LOGBOOK • Log a flight in seconds — the aircraft type auto-detects • Works fully offline; syncs securely when you're back online • 600+ aircraft types and 21,000+ airports built in • Offline route map on every flight • Import from any CSV

records.name: MyPyMentor
records.tagline: Learn Python with an AI tutor that actually remembers you
records.description: MyPyMentor is the only Python platform that learns you back. 69% of learners quit online Python courses before finishing, usually because generic tutorials don't know who you are or when you're stuck. Py, your AI tutor, remembers every session and picks up exactly where you left off. It teaches Socratically, detects frustration in real time, and pairs with an in-browser Python editor, daily challenges, and 8 structured learning paths. No credit card required.

records.name: Harbofly
records.tagline: Reclaim the GBs dev caches and LLM weights hide on your Mac
records.description: Harbofly is a free, open-source menu bar app (plus CLI) that finds the gigabytes dev tools hide: DerivedData, node_modules, Gradle, Homebrew caches, even LLM weights from Ollama, and frees them safely: risk tiers, Trash-first, source code never touched. It spots idle projects via your local git (warning about unpushed work), explains macOS "purgeable" space, auto-cleans on your terms for free, where alternatives charge $29, and speaks 6 languages. No account, no Pro plan, opt-in telemetry.

records.name: SingleToSpouse
records.tagline: A Christian directory to find love, vet well marry right.
records.description: SingleToSpouse is a curated directory of Christian resources from around the world, designed to support every stage of the journey from singleness to marriage. Whether you're looking to meet someone, evaluate relationship compatibility, prepare for engagement, or plan your wedding, the platform brings together vetted apps, services, communities, events, professionals, educational resources, and more, all in one place.

records.name: Markdown Library ML-42
records.tagline: Browse, read, and edit markdown files across every project.
records.description: A native macOS reader and editor for the markdown already on your disk. Point ML-42 at any folder — a git repo, a docs directory, an Obsidian vault — and read, search, and edit across projects. No import, no database; files stay where they are. Cmd+K searches every project at once. When an AI agent rewrites a file, ML-42 reloads it in place. On-device summaries via Apple Intelligence. Sandboxed — no network, no telemetry. $12.99, buy once. Mac, no subscription.

records.name: GitHub
records.tagline: Sageport - SSH Workbench
records.description: SSH workbench with integrated SFTP, credential management, and an AI assistant. - joygqz/sageport

records.name: Auto Reload Page
records.tagline: Auto reload website for Safari
records.description: Auto Reload Page is a Safari extension that helps you refresh web pages faster and more conveniently on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Set an interval once, start auto reload, and keep pages updated without pulling to refresh again and again. Features Quick reload for the current Safari page. Auto reload with your chosen interval. Easy start and stop controls from the Safari extension. Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac through Safari extension. Clean and simple interface focused on fast page refreshing.

records.name: LongShort
records.tagline: PvP Bitcoin trading arena where skill earns crypto
records.description: LongShort is a PvP simulated Bitcoin day trading arena. Trade leveraged LONG/SHORT through monthly seasons, climb a skill-based leaderboard, and prove you're an apex trader. No deposit, no wallet needed to play. Up to 5% of WICK token supply is reserved for beta testers.

records.name: The Great British List
records.tagline: UK directory of trusted local businesses
records.description: The Great British List is a UK online business directory and local discovery platform that connects consumers with businesses, services, events, and community resources across the United Kingdom. It enables businesses to create detailed listings, improve their online visibility, and attract local customers through searchable profiles, reviews, and promotional opportunities.

records.name: LivCapture
records.tagline: Record your screen effortlessly in high quality
records.description: Capture your screen, application window, or Chrome tab with LivCapture. Create professional-quality videos using cursor highlights, click effects, keyboard shortcut display, live zoom, webcam overlay, automatic subtitles, and high-quality audio recording.

records.name: Willow Frontier Pro
records.tagline: The fastest, most accurate dictation model in the world
records.description: Willow is launching two new voice AI models: Willow Frontier Pro and Willow Frontier Mini. Frontier Pro is our most powerful dictation model. It is built for people who want fast, accurate, and polished writing anywhere they work. Frontier mini is lightweight and completely free to use. On our free plan, users get unlimited access to this model. It's faster and more accurate than other AI dictation tools.

records.name: Widgy
records.tagline: The form builder your AI uses
records.description: Connect Widgy to Claude or ChatGPT over MCP. Say "build me an intake form" and get a live, shareable link in seconds — then let your AI read the answers as they come in. Lead qualifiers, client intake, RSVPs, research, scored forms. It's live, and it's free.

records.name: All Morse Code
records.tagline: Free Morse code translator for text, audio & images
records.description: Free Morse code translator: convert text to Morse code or decode Morse to text instantly. Audio beep playback, light signal mode, typing trainer, and flashcards. No signup needed.

records.name: 100Xtuber
records.tagline: Every YouTube tool you need, free. No signup.
records.description: 100Xtuber gives YouTubers free tools to grow: YouTube thumbnail downloader, tranfree YouTube tools in one place: 4K thumbnail downloader, CTR predictor, AI tag generator, transcript extractor, CPM & RPM estimator, video idea generator, and YouTube to MP3/MP4 downloader. No signup required. No usage caps. No upsell walls. I got tired of basic creator tools hiding behind expensive monthly subscriptions, so I built the ultimate free toolkit. Built by creators, for creators.

records.name: Mailsurity
records.tagline: Catch the fake Emails your blocklist lets through.
records.description: Catch the disposable emails your blocklist misses. Mailsurity runs a 5-step detection pipeline, layering MX-server fingerprinting, entropy checks, and mail-cluster reputation scoring on top of curated domain lists, to catch burner and throwaway addresses no static list has ever seen. Get a real-time REST API, bulk CSV checks, per-team allow/deny rules, and a free tier so you can start filtering signups today.

records.name: ChannelOS.tv
records.tagline: AI digital signage: pair a TV, publish in two minutes
records.description: The anti-Yodeck: digital signage stripped to three verbs — Pair, Build, Publish. Open one URL on any TV (Android, Google, Fire TV, webOS) to pair it — no install. Describe your business and AI drafts every slide, then keeps editing the show in plain words as prices change. Run the whole wall from one live board — play, pause, blank, swap, schedule. Your first screen is free forever. Background removal, Pexels media, live widgets and remixable templates, built in.
